channel.description: Bar and Bench is India's premier legal news website, providing comprehensive coverage of the Indian legal system. Stay updated with the latest Supreme Court judgments, High Court orders, legal news, and analysis.

item.title: Savarkar defamation: Kin alleges security lapse, failure to examine witnesses in Mahatma Gandhi killing
item.media:keywords: Mahatma Gandhi,Rahul Gandhi,Defamation,Pune Court,Vinayak Savarkar,Satyaki Savarkar
item.content:encoded: Vinayak Savarkar was not involved in the conspiracy or killing of Mahatma Gandhi, Savarkar's grandnephew Satyaki Savarkar maintained before a Pune court on Tuesday [Satyaki Savarkar v. Rahul Gandhi]

item.title: Supreme Court upholds reopening of tax assessments against former CJI YK Sabharwal’s sons
item.media:keywords: Supreme Court of India,Income Tax Department,Justice YK Sabharwal,Justice JB Pardiwala,Income tax assessment,Justice Vinod Chandran
item.content:encoded: The Supreme Court recently upheld the reopening of income-tax assessments against businessmen Chetan Sabharwal and Nitin Sabharwal, sons of former Chief Justice of India late YK Sabharwal, over share transactions involving a total consideration of ₹255 crore [Chetan Sabharwal v. ACIT, New Delhi].

item.title: CEC protests: Delhi court seeks police report on journalist's plea for sexual assault FIR against ACP
item.media:keywords: Delhi Police,Patiala House Court,CEC,journalist,Gyanesh Kumar,Delhi Protests
item.content:encoded: A Delhi court on Tuesday sought a report from the Delhi Police on a plea filed by independent journalist Rosy seeking registration of a first information report (FIR) against Delhi Police officer Vivek Bhagat for allegedly sexually assaulting her during the protest against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar.
